summary: First end-to-end MVP test of TrackMP. Backend smoke tests + full UI flow (login → create politician → add promise → upvote → rate → comment → add work → logout) all pass. Auth (cookie + Bearer fallback) works, all CRUD endpoints respond correctly, stats endpoint reflects activity.
passed: POST /api/politicians/{id}/promises creates promise (title min 3 chars enforced)
UI: Login via /login with admin creds → redirected to /feed
UI: Create politician via /politicians/new → redirected to detail page
UI: Add promise dialog → promise card appears
UI: 5-star rating widget records rating (header shows 5 (1 ratings))
UI: Add comment → comment card appears
UI: Add work via dialog → work card appears
UI: Navbar logout clears auth and returns to / with Login/Sign up buttons visible
notes: Backend models require: PromiseIn.title >=3 chars, VoteIn uses field `value` (not `vote`), RatingIn uses field `score` (not `rating`). Frontend correctly sends the matching field names. Test credentials file present at /app/memory/test_credentials.md and accurate.
